brief.goal: Make the shared partial-baseline evaluator the sole decision source for event-config preflight and Node 04 event-chain classification.

allowed_writes: Solution Design, Task, Context Manifest, AGENTS and current mechanism/data/lessons documentation
existing event-config preflight and Node 04 readonly classification
current Case fresh readonly recovery through the existing workbench command
forbidden_actions: all real platform writes, confirmation consumption, retries and action grants
OAuth refresh, std_project/resource create, budget or bid mutation
new API, Schema, View, Gate, Plan/action type or worker
persisting sensitive data, raw platform payloads/responses or event ID lists
validation_plan: event-config and event-chain partial-baseline regression smoke
all live event, resource registry and confirmed-resource orchestrator smoke
workflow, API, workbench, schema, data-contract, security and runtime-consistency checks
restart workbench and run only fresh readonly recovery for the current Case
stop_conditions: a real platform write, automatic confirmation, retry or credential refresh would be required
the shared evaluator cannot distinguish configured baseline entries from available candidates
the implementation requires a database, Gate, Plan or public API change

outcome.next_user_action: 在工作台对当前 fresh resource_prepare Plan 输入精确“确认准备资源”后，既有主链才可执行冻结的资源动作。
